{{Top|leg}}
'''Meditation of Immersion''', or '''Force immersion''', was a [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|technique]] that stilled the mental and physical state of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] who performed it to a profound level. This allowed the user to attain an almost direct contact with the [[White Current/Legends|White Current]]. In this state, the Fallanassi could become completely invisible, or project images around them with vivid clarity. Masters of Force immersion were capable of immersing others outside of themselves, such as another person or even objects, into the Current.
